questions.prompt: The messenger, wounded and exhausted, was a faithful friend.
questions.answer: Nūntius, saucius et fessus, amīcus fidēlis erat.

questions.prompt: Listen, my son, for hunger is a harsh master.
questions.answer: Audī, mī fīlī, nam famēs magister dūrus est.

questions.prompt: You are brave, Marcus, but your brother is more cautious.
questions.answer: Fortis es, Mārce, sed frāter tuus cautior est.

questions.prompt: Bread and water were the soldier's only food.
questions.answer: Pānis et aqua sōlus cibus mīlitis erant.

questions.prompt: The old man, worn out by a long life, became a wise teacher.
questions.answer: Senex, longā vītā fessus, magister sapiēns factus est.

questions.prompt: Beware, friend: the enemy is cunning and swift.
questions.answer: Cavē, amīce: hostis callidus et celer est.

questions.prompt: The poet's song was sweet, and his fame is eternal.
questions.answer: Carmen poētae dulce erat, et fāma eius aeterna est.

questions.prompt: You alone, Quintus, are the hope of the fatherland.
questions.answer: Tū sōlus, Quīnte, spēs patriae es.

questions.prompt: Thirst is a cruel enemy for travelers in the desert.
questions.answer: Sitis viātōribus in dēsertō hostis crūdēlis est.

questions.prompt: Rejoice, citizens, for the war is finished and peace is near!
questions.answer: Gaudēte, cīvēs, nam bellum cōnfectum est et pāx propinqua est.

questions.prompt: The general was fierce, but the king was merciful.
questions.answer: Dux ferōx erat, sed rēx clēmēns erat.

questions.prompt: My son, silence is often the wisest counsel.
questions.answer: Fīlī mī, silentium saepe cōnsilium sapientissimum est.

questions.prompt: The waves were high, and the sailors' fear was great.
questions.answer: Undae altae erant, et nautārum timor magnus erat.

questions.prompt: Nature is the best teacher of all things.
questions.answer: Nātūra optima magistra omnium rērum est.

questions.prompt: Servant, bring the wine, for the guests are already here.
questions.answer: Serve, vīnum fer, nam hospitēs iam adsunt.

questions.prompt: The stars, scattered across the sky, are countless.
questions.answer: Stēllae, per caelum sparsae, innumerābilēs sunt.

questions.prompt: The victory was ours, but the price was heavy.
questions.answer: Victōria nostra erat, sed pretium grave erat.

questions.prompt: The physician's remedy was bitter but useful.
questions.answer: Medicīna medicī amāra sed ūtilis erat.

questions.prompt: Be strong, comrades, for the gods favor the bold!
questions.answer: Fortēs este, sociī, nam deī audācēs adiuvant.

questions.prompt: The letter, written by a friend, was a great comfort.
questions.answer: Epistula, ab amīcō scrīpta, magnum sōlācium erat.

questions.prompt: You are the light of my life, daughter.
questions.answer: Tū lūx vītae meae es, fīlia.

questions.prompt: The old man, though poor, was a most steadfast citizen.
questions.answer: Senex, quamquam pauper, cīvis cōnstantissimus erat.

questions.prompt: The queen was beautiful, but her spirit was fierce.
questions.answer: Rēgīna pulchra erat, sed animus eius ferōx.

questions.prompt: The mountains, covered with snow, are a terrible sight for travelers.
questions.answer: Montēs, nive tēctī, terribile spectāculum viātōribus sunt.

questions.prompt: Wisdom is the surest guardian of a tranquil life.
questions.answer: Sapientia tranquillae vītae cūstōs certissimus est.

questions.prompt: Flee, Marcus, for the enemy is already at the gates!
questions.answer: Fuge, Mārce, nam hostis iam ad portās est.

questions.prompt: Be silent, servant, while the master is sleeping.
questions.answer: Tacē, serve, dum dominus dormit.

questions.prompt: O citizens, the fatherland calls you to arms.
questions.answer: Ō cīvēs, patria vōs ad arma vocat.

questions.prompt: Silence is often the wisest answer of a prudent man.
questions.answer: Silentium saepe prūdentis virī sapientissimum respōnsum est.

questions.prompt: The ripe dates were a sweet gift for the guests.
questions.answer: Caryōtae mātūrae dulce dōnum hospitibus erant.

questions.prompt: This book is the beginning of a longer work.
questions.answer: Hic liber longiōris operis exordium est.

questions.prompt: You, O judge, are the last hope of the innocent.
questions.answer: Tū, ō iūdex, innocentium spēs ultima es.

questions.prompt: Rise, Quintus, because the sun has already touched the hills.
questions.answer: Surge, Quīnte, quia sōl iam collēs tetigit.

questions.prompt: The eager student reads the ancient books late into the night.
questions.answer: Discipulus studiōsus antīquōs librōs in multam noctem legit.

questions.prompt: Spare the conquered, O victor, for mercy is the mark of a great soul.
questions.answer: Parce victīs, ō victor, nam clēmentia magnī animī signum est.

questions.prompt: The falling leaf, driven by the wind, touched the still water.
questions.answer: Folium cadēns, ventō āctum, aquam quiētam tetigit.

questions.prompt: The sailors, worn out by the long voyage, were happy men.
questions.answer: Nautae, longā nāvigātiōne cōnfectī, laetī virī erant.

questions.prompt: Health is a greater good than wealth, my friends.
questions.answer: Salūs maius bonum quam dīvitiae est, amīcī meī.

questions.prompt: The nervous speaker, pale and hesitant, vomited before the crowd.
questions.answer: Ōrātor sollicitus, pallidus et dubius, ante turbam vomuit.

questions.prompt: You are the master, Davus, but I am a free man.
questions.answer: Tū dominus es, Dāve, sed ego līber homō sum.

questions.prompt: The winter was harsh, and the roads were treacherous.
questions.answer: Hiems aspera erat, et viae perīculōsae erant.

questions.prompt: You, O brave centurion, are the guardian of the camp.
questions.answer: Tū, ō centuriō fortis, es custōs castrōrum.

questions.prompt: Listen, Marcus, for the shining star is a sign of the gods.
questions.answer: Audī, Marce, nam stēlla lūcida signum deōrum est.

questions.prompt: Slavery is a heavy burden, but liberty is a sweet reward.
questions.answer: Servitūs onus grave est, sed lībertās praemium dulce est.

questions.prompt: My son, the labor of the fields is long but honest.
questions.answer: Fīlī mī, labor agrōrum longus sed honestus est.

questions.prompt: The forgetting of injuries is the mark of a great mind.
questions.answer: Oblīviō iniūriārum magnī animī signum est.

questions.prompt: Servant, why do you insult the wretched captives?
questions.answer: Serve, cūr miserīs captīvīs īnsultās?

questions.prompt: The watchful sentinel was silent, and the night was dark.
questions.answer: Vigil prōvidēns tacitus erat, et nox obscūra erat.
